title: Understanding Principal Components
text: When performing PCA, each principal component explains a certain amount of variance in the data. Think about how the explained variance changes as you add more components. Does it always increase significantly?

title: Explained Variance in PCA
text: Consider the concept of cumulative explained variance. As you add more principal components, the cumulative explained variance increases. However, does it always increase at the same rate?

title: Evaluating the Scree Plot
text: Look at the scree plot. Does the explained variance increase significantly after a certain number of components?
